decisions.decision: Start now. Run `git merge-base --is-ancestor e4bd0b8 origin/main`. If it passes, branch from main. If not, branch from tantra-walkthroughs and rebase onto main later. Fix every finding in workshop-cards.ts and agent.tsx as the spec says. N041: limits 250–350 (nl_1..4) and 40–90 (nl_wa), with the range in each label. N042: remove the SMS promise. N058: say 'test inboxes' for Resend or Tantra. N086: use WARMUP_DAYS everywhere. N087: remove the unsourced list size. N093: make hw_proof optional and add an example. X073: build the GHL, HubSpot and Zoho contact search import using the attendee's own key (KEEP per T-260, 2026-10-09). Do not mark it obsolete. N051: if the Sales Navigator text is gone on main, mark it obsolete. If not, ask for the LinkedIn URL. Copy follows the Backlinko voice. Run probe-day1/day2 and the gate, commit, and post READY in LOG.md. Mark each id fixed in AUDIT.md with its commit SHA.
